title: 第6章  吞噬
content_zh:
苏烬生看着被吃的只剩下骨头的胡荣，心中顿感解气，脸上也露出一个戏谑的笑容。
活命的机会可是给你了，没把握住，可就不能怪他了！
黑煞狼的獠牙上满是血迹，连带着面部灰色毛发也被染红，一双幽绿的眸子缓缓抬起。
最终落到了苏烬生的身上，一股森然寒意涌现而出。
显然，一个胡荣并不能满足它的胃口，它还想要将苏烬生也一并吞入腹中。
而这也在苏烬生的意料之中，毕竟，一头丈高的妖兽，又岂会是百十斤肉能满足的？
之所以没有离开，是因为这一级初期妖兽的身上，诸多地方都可售卖，且价值不菲。
就这一头一级初期妖兽，至少能售卖五十枚下品灵石！
这对于当前的他来说，可是迫切需要的。
“嗷~呜……”
黑煞狼嚎叫一声之后，便迈动四肢，速度飞快的朝着苏烬生撕咬而去。
血盆大口张开，獠牙外露，凶猛至极！
苏烬生神色认真，不敢大意，双眼微微眯起，浓郁的灵气输送至剑刃上。
凌厉剑气蓄势待发！
下一刻，丈高身躯便已高高跃起，双爪在前，仿佛要撕开苏烬生的胸膛一般，来势汹汹。
獠牙直咬脖颈，若是咬中，那苏烬生将必死无疑！
“断岳斩！！”
苏烬生面色凝重，低沉的声音从口中响起，双手持剑，猛然挥斩而落！
“轰！！”
凡阶高级武技，断岳斩，直接施展而出！

“噗！！”
剑气直接斩中黑煞狼头颅，鲜血飞溅而出，丈高身躯当即摔倒在地上，没了气息。
这一击，直接消耗了他四分之三的灵气，即便是一级中期妖兽都很难抵挡。
这一级初期妖兽，正面抗衡也就只有死路一条而已。
妖兽等级划分为一至九级，每级又分初期，中期，后期。
“呼！”
苏烬生吐出一口浊气，心中略微惊喜几分，原本他以为这一记武技会消耗他所有灵气。
却不曾想，竟然还留有几分，看来这神秘种子转化过的灵气比他想象的还要强悍几分。
步伐迈动，手提利剑上前，挥动间，便已将这黑煞狼的头颅斩开。
“砰！”
一道清脆之声响起，一枚拳头大小的妖核映入眼帘。
这妖核通体为紫色，水晶状，内含有狂暴的灵气，乃是这妖兽体内最为值钱之物。
相当于人类的丹田一样，储存灵气。
只不过，人类死后，丹田内的灵气会消散，但妖兽却不会。
苏烬生伸手去拿，触碰的瞬间，丹田内神秘种子的吸扯力骤然加大。
妖核内的狂暴灵气连带着黑煞狼血肉中的力量被尽数吞噬入丹田之中。
苏烬生微微一愣，随即立刻控制神秘种子，停止吞噬。
要知道，这妖兽的灵气都十分狂暴，若是贸然吞噬，会损害筋脉丹田。
严重者会穿肠破肚，丧命当场！
下一刻，神识潜入丹田之中，却发现那些狂暴的灵气围绕在神秘种子四周，乖顺无比。

仿佛普通灵气一般，转化为精纯的灵气后，便沉入丹田中！
这，这神秘种子竟然能够转化妖兽的狂暴灵气！
苏烬生圆瞪双目，眼中满是震惊之色，久久不曾回神！
要知道，这妖核内的灵气虽然狂暴，但却非常浓郁，仅是一枚一级初期妖核，就顶得上三百枚下品灵石！
而这也只是一级初期妖核而已，等级越高的妖核，含有的灵气就越浓郁。
因为妖核容易获得，且灵气浓厚，不知多少武者用尽了万千种方法吞噬，都以失败告终，不得已而放弃。
而他丹田内的种子竟然能够吞噬这狂暴灵气，且无半点副作用！
岂不是说，这山脉之中的妖兽，就等同于行走的修炼资源。
震惊之后，心中一阵狂喜！
有如此逆天的功效，他的修炼速度恐怕还会提升数倍！
一年之内，别说聚灵境，就算是归元境也不是没有可能！
苏烬生脸上笑容浓郁，眼中却是寒光闪烁，轻声道。
“姜紫嫣，我倒要看看，你如何与我斗！！”
音落，手掌落到了那妖核上，神秘种子再度开始运转，狂暴的灵气被肆意吞噬，涌入丹田。
那庞大的尸体也以肉眼可见的速度干瘪下去！
不到半刻钟时间，黑煞狼的尸体便已宛若干尸一般，躺在地上。
那枚妖核也已无半点灵气，如普通晶石一般，黯然失色。
而苏烬生则是顺利突破至炼气四重境！
强悍的灵气流转四肢，力量充沛，整个人较比先前强悍了五倍不止！
若是再碰见这黑煞狼，只需要挥动剑刃便可将之斩杀，根本无需动用武技。

一枚妖核加这庞大的妖兽躯体，相当于三百三十枚下品灵石了，直接被他尽数吞噬！
突破境界，也是再正常不过了！
只不过，若是再想突破境界，就不是一头一级初期妖兽所能够满足的了。
恐怕至少也要五头一级初期妖兽，或者两头一级中期妖兽才行！
这对于他来说，简直再轻松不过了。
先前他为内门弟子第一人之时，时常在这山脉之中历练，猎杀的妖兽数不胜数。
凭借丰富的经验，一天杀个两三头一级初期妖兽，还是十分轻松的。
到时候，境界突破起来，还不是跟吃饭喝水一样简单？
从昨日丹田恢复至今，才不到两天时间，他便已经达到炼气四重境。
这恐怖速度若是传出去，恐怕会引得全宗震惊！
苏烬生抑制心中激动，将刚才从胡荣身上搜到的修炼资源拿了出来，轻点一下。
共有凝气丹三枚，下品灵石五十五枚，还有一柄下品凡器，也能值一百下品灵石。
如今的他有九枚凝气丹，三百九十五枚下品灵石，应当足以再让他突破一重境界了！
只要能达到炼气五重境，便可再度参加外门弟子考核，成为外门弟子。
成为外门弟子后，便可灵气更加丰厚的修炼资源。
届时，境界提升速度一定会更快几分！
就是不知道，成为外门弟子后，当初欺辱他的那些人，会是何等的表情。
苏烬生摇了摇头，不再多想，将眼前的黑煞狼尸体处理掉之后，便朝着山脉别处走去。
如今他不仅需要寻找百灵草，还需要猎杀一级初期妖兽来提升境界！
content_en:
Su Jinsheng looked at Hu Rong who had been eaten with only bones left. He felt relieved and had a joking smile on his face.
You were given a chance to survive. If you didn't take it, you can't blame him!
The black wolf's fangs were covered in blood, and even the gray hair on its face was dyed red. A pair of green eyes slowly raised.
Finally it fell on Su Jinsheng, and a chill came out.
Obviously, one Hu Rong could not satisfy its appetite, and it wanted to swallow Su Jinsheng as well.
And this was what Su Jinsheng had expected. After all, how could a ten-foot-tall monster be satisfied with a hundred pounds of meat?
The reason why he didn't leave was because this early stage monster could be sold in many places and was worth a lot of money.
Just this first-level early-stage monster can sell at least fifty low-grade spiritual stones!
This is urgently needed for him now.
"Ouch~ow..."
After the black wolf howled, it moved its limbs and bit at Su Jinsheng very quickly.
The bloody mouth is open, the fangs are exposed, it is extremely ferocious!
Su Jinsheng looked serious and did not dare to be careless. He narrowed his eyes slightly and sent rich spiritual energy to the blade.
The fierce sword energy is ready to go!
The next moment, his tall body jumped up high, with his claws in front, as if he was about to tear Su Jinsheng's chest apart, coming menacingly.
The fangs bite straight into the neck. If the bite hits, Su Jinsheng will definitely die!
"Broken Mountain Slash!!"
Su Jinsheng's face was solemn, a deep voice sounded from his mouth, he held the sword in both hands and slashed down suddenly!
"Boom!!"
The advanced mortal martial arts skill, Mountain Breaking Slash, is performed directly!
"Poof!!"
The sword energy directly hit the black evil wolf's head, blood spattered out, and the tall body fell to the ground immediately, lifeless.
This blow directly consumed three-quarters of his spiritual energy, and it was difficult for even a mid-level monster to resist.
At this level of early-stage monster, the only way to confront it head-on is to die.
The levels of monsters are divided into levels one to nine, and each level is divided into early stage, middle stage and late stage.
"Phew!"
Su Jinsheng exhaled a breath of turbid air, feeling a little surprised. Originally, he thought that this martial skill would consume all his spiritual energy.
But he never thought that there was still a bit left. It seemed that the aura transformed by this mysterious seed was a bit more powerful than he imagined.
He took a step forward and stepped forward with a sharp sword in his hand. With a single swing, he cut off the black wolf's head.
"Bang!"
A crisp sound sounded, and a fist-sized demon core came into view.
This demonic core is purple in color, crystal-like, and contains violent spiritual energy. It is the most valuable thing in this demonic beast.
It is equivalent to the human Dantian, which stores spiritual energy.
However, after the death of a human being, the spiritual energy in the Dantian will dissipate, but the monster beast will not.
Su Jinsheng reached out to take it. The moment he touched it, the suction force of the mysterious seeds in his dantian suddenly increased.
The violent spiritual energy in the demon core and the power in the black evil wolf's flesh and blood were all swallowed into the dantian.
Su Jinsheng was stunned for a moment, then immediately controlled the mysterious seeds and stopped swallowing them.
You must know that the spiritual energy of this monster is very violent. If it is swallowed hastily, it will damage the muscles and Dantian.
In severe cases, the intestines will be ruptured and the person will die on the spot!
The next moment, his spiritual consciousness sneaked into the dantian, only to find that the violent spiritual energy surrounded the mysterious seeds, extremely obedient.
Just like ordinary spiritual energy, after it is transformed into pure spiritual energy, it sinks into the dantian!
This, this mysterious seed can actually transform the violent aura of the monster!
Su Jinsheng's eyes widened with shock, and he didn't come back to his senses for a long time!
You know, although the spiritual energy in this demon core is violent, it is very rich. Just one first-level initial demon core is worth three hundred low-grade spiritual stones!
And this is only the first-level demon core. The higher the level of the demon core, the richer the spiritual energy it contains.
Because the demon core is easy to obtain and the spiritual energy is strongHou, countless warriors have tried countless ways to devour it, but they all ended in failure and had to give up.
And the seeds in his Dantian were able to swallow this violent spiritual energy without any side effects!
Doesn't it mean that the monsters in this mountain range are equivalent to walking cultivation resources?
After being shocked, there was a burst of ecstasy in my heart!
With such a heaven-defying effect, his cultivation speed may increase several times!
Within a year, let alone the Soul Gathering Realm, even the Guiyuan Realm is not impossible!
Su Jinsheng had a bright smile on his face, but a cold light flashed in his eyes, and he said softly.
"Jiang Ziyan, I want to see how you fight with me!!"
As the sound fell, his palm fell on the demon core, and the mysterious seeds began to circulate again. The violent spiritual energy was swallowed up wantonly and poured into the Dantian.
The huge corpse shriveled up at a speed visible to the naked eye!
In less than half a quarter of an hour, the body of the Black Evil Wolf was lying on the ground like several corpses.
The demonic core also had no aura at all, and was eclipsed like an ordinary crystal.
Su Jinsheng, on the other hand, successfully broke through to the fourth level of Qi refining!
The powerful spiritual energy flows through the limbs, full of strength, and the whole person is more than five times stronger than before!
If you encounter this black evil wolf again, you only need to swing your sword to kill it without using any martial arts.
One demon core plus this huge demon beast body is equivalent to three hundred and thirty low-grade spiritual stones, and he will swallow them all!
Breaking through the realm is completely normal!
However, if you want to break through the realm again, it will not be satisfied by an early stage first-level monster.
I'm afraid it would take at least five first-level early stage monsters, or two mid-level first-level monsters!
This couldn't be easier for him.
When he was the first disciple of the inner sect, he often practiced in this mountain range and hunted countless monsters.
With rich experience, it is very easy to kill two or three first-level monsters in a day.
When the time comes, breaking through the realm will not be as simple as eating and drinking water?
In less than two days since his Dantian recovered yesterday, he has reached the fourth level of Qi refining.
If this terrifying speed were to spread, it would probably shock the entire sect!
Su Jinsheng suppressed his excitement, took out the cultivation resources he had just found from Hu Rong, and tapped them lightly.
There are three Qi Condensing Pills, fifty-five low-grade spiritual stones, and a low-grade mortal weapon worth a hundred low-grade spiritual stones.
Now he has nine Qi Condensing Pills and 395 low-grade spirit stones, which should be enough for him to break through to the first level again!
As long as you can reach the fifth level of Qi Refining, you can take the outer disciple assessment again and become an outer disciple.
After becoming an outer disciple, you will have more abundant spiritual energy cultivation resources.
By then, the speed of realm improvement will definitely be faster!
He just didn't know what the expressions of those who had bullied him would be like after he became an outer disciple.
Su Jinsheng shook his head and thought no more. After disposing of the black wolf corpse in front of him, he walked towards other parts of the mountain range.
Now he not only needs to find lark, but also needs to hunt down the first-level early-stage monsters to improve his realm!
